data.name: Zong
data.detailed_description:
Overview

English Intro

Zong is a first-person VR novel that takes you on a journey through ancient Eastern history and culture. As an interstellar traveler, you find yourself in the world of Zong, which is currently in a dire situation under the grips of the Five Clans of Corruption. You will be completing missions to save ancient civilization from the corruptive forces and transmit important learnings to earth, while being guided by Zong's spiritual leaders, the four Supreme Commanders. As you progress through the game, you will encounter various challenges that require strategy, skill, and wit. Get ready to cast spells, summon magical creatures, solve puzzles, collect rare items, and more!

中文简介

在浩大的宇宙里，存在着一个时空维度——宗界，宗界是高级文明的始祖，生生不息，维护着无数星河的星际安全，更有着监测人类一族的使命与维护人间地球运转的责任。在过去的时间长河里，宗界与人间地球一直保持着距离，与人类一族各自为生，却没料想随着人类技术的发展与生产力的解放，人类试图逾越自宇宙初开以来与宗界之间的界限，不断地通过各式各样的方式想要抵达宗界，甚至窥探宗界中的动向，扰乱宗界生灵们的生产与生活。宗界生灵们经过商讨，为了预防人类的好奇心破坏宗界与人类一族的界限，决定挑选合适的人类，给他们在宗界中行动与信息交流的权限，如果他们能够经受住宗界的考验并与宗界生灵们和平相处，便给予他们周秭信函，让该选定的人把信函发送到人间地球，作为传递宗界与人间地球之间信息的人类使者。密函里面内容不一，但无一不关乎人类的生命与生活的七大主题：生死、名利、善施、至亲、爱人、博学、友忠。

Zong

The cosmos was in chaos, and Zong first emerged. "Dynamic spirits" and "Still spirits" are the primordial states of all things—they engender and restrain each other, acting as mutual gravitational forces.

宇宙混沌，宗界初开。“动”与“静”为万物之始态，⼆者相⽣相克，互为引⼒。

Zong is the progenitor of advanced civilizations, composed of the Arcane Ranks and a multitude of living beings. Those who hold the title of Arcane Ranks are designated by the corresponding hierarchical grades: Supreme Commander – Primary Commander – Ancillary Commander – Auxiliary Commander. The Supreme Commanders are the highest rulers of Zong, traditionally chosen as two pairs of Primordial Conjunctions—the most virtuous and accomplished among all in Zong—totaling four commanders. The Primary Commanders are the pillars that have stood since the dawn of primordial chaos; they oversee different aspects of Zong, ensuring its normal and peaceful operation. Beneath the pillars are the Ancillary Commanders, who assist the Primary Commanders in managing various affairs across Zong. They are on the path toward becoming Primary Commanders, laboring diligently in hopes of earning recognition from the rulers of Zong. Below the Ancillary Commanders are the Auxiliary Commanders, who are neither managers nor formulators of Zong's rules, but rather adherents to them. In the day-to-day operations of Zong, they safeguard both the living beings of Zong and the lives of the Arcane Ranks.

宗界为⾼级⽂明的始祖，由“将”与⼀众⽣灵组成。若为“将”，则记以相应⽞位：“上上将 - 上将 - 中将 - ⼠将 ”。“上上将”为宗界最⾼之统领，素来由宗界中遴选出的两对最为德才兼备的连理胜任，共四将。“上将”均为万物混沌之初之梁柱，他们分管宗界不同⽅⾯，让宗界可以正常且和平地运转。“中将”为梁柱之下，他们协助上将们⼀起管理宗界中不同⽅⾯的事务，正在⾛向成为“上将”的道路上，他们努⼒耕耘，希冀得到宗界统领们的认可。“⼠将”为中将之下的阶位，他们并⾮宗界规则的管理者和制定者，⽽是规则的遵循者，在⽇常宗界的运营中，他们维护着宗界的⽣灵以及将们的⽣活。

For those who are not of the Arcane Ranks but are living beings of Zong—such as flowers, trees, grasses, serpents, birds, fish, insects, or even shadow spirits that accompany one—they are designated by the corresponding hierarchical grades for beings: Grana – Cyma – Virga – Thalla – Virgulta – Catoma – Palma – Amicula – Umbra – Silva, ranging from lowest to highest, all of whom are members of Zong. These beings are not subject to the constraints of the Arcane Ranks in their daily lives; as long as they do not violate the laws of Zong or endanger the vitality of other beings within Zong, they are free to live as they please. The beings of Zong may engage in self-cultivation, and through this process, they can elevate their Arcane Rank within Zong and correspondingly enhance their life force. Upon reaching the rank of Silva, a being gains the qualification to transform into the form of an Arcane Rank. However, should a being wish to retain its original ecological form, it may decline the opportunity to assume such a form. Thus, it is common to see within Zong that even the Arcane Ranks may appear as flowers, trees, grasses, serpents, birds, fish, insects, or shadow spirits in their company.

若⾮为将，⽽为宗界⽣灵，如花草树⽊，又如蛇鸟鱼⾍，复如影灵随⾏，则记以⽣灵相应的⽞位：“芥 - 株 - 秧 - 丛 - 齐 - ⽐ - 枝 - 蓬 - 茵 - 擎”，由低到⾼均为宗界成员。⽣灵们在⽣活上不受将的制约，只要不违逆宗界之法则，且不危害宗界其他⽣灵的⽣命⼒，便可⾃由地⽣活。宗界的⽣灵可好⽣修养，修养的过程中会提⾼⾃⼰的宗界⽞位与相应的⽣命⼒量。待⽣灵升⾄“擎”位，则可获得幻化为将形的资格，如若⽣灵想要保留⾃⼰原始的⽣态，可以拒绝化为将形的机会。因此，可常见宗界中也有将为花草树⽊、蛇鸟鱼⾍、影灵随⾏。

While maintaining its own self-sustaining operations, Zong also bears the mission of observing human activities and safeguarding the functioning of the earthly realm. Since the dawn of Zong, it has passed through the Gratia Melius and the Cordia Benevolens, and now has arrived at the Anima Gravis. In the bygone Arcane Eras, Zong perceived humanity's growing desire to obtain more information from Zong, and observed that among humans—some burned incense, some lit candles, some prayed, some cried out, and some went so far as to attempt entering Zong by means unacceptable to the Zong lineage, seeking to probe its realities and spy on the movements within. To prevent human curiosity from breaching the boundary between Zong and the human race, Zong resolved to select suitable humans, granting them the authority to operate and exchange information within Zong. If they could withstand the trials of Zong, they would be bestowed with the Tabulae Grana, charging the chosen individuals to transmit the letters to the earthly realm, thereby serving as human envoys bridging Zong and the human world. The contents of the missives vary, yet each without exception pertains to the Seven Principal Themes of Human Life: Vitality, Prosperity, Charity, Consanguinity, Devotion, Erudition, and Amity.

宗界在维持⾃我运转的同时，也兼备观测⼈类活动、维护⼈间地球运转的使命。⾃宗界初开以来，其已然经历了慈化纪元，悯仁纪元，现如今⾛到稠念纪元。在以往的纪元⾥，宗界感受到⼈类想要从宗界获得更多信息的意愿，并发现在⼈类中，有的焚⾹，有的点烛，有的祷告，有的呐喊，更有甚者，试图⽤宗族不能认可的⼿段进⼊宗界中探听虚实，窥视宗界中的动静。为了预防⼈类的好奇⼼破坏宗界与⼈类⼀族的界限，宗界决定挑选合适的⼈类，给他们在宗界中⾏动与信息交流的权限，如果他们能够经受住宗界的考验，便给予他们周秭信函，让该选定的⼈把信函发送到⼈间地球，作为传递宗界与⼈间地球之间信息的⼈类使者。密函⾥⾯内容不⼀，但⽆⼀不关乎⼈类的⽣命与⽣活的七⼤主题：⽣死、名利、善施、⾄亲、爱⼈、博学、友忠。

In the bygone Arcane Eras, Zong once selected certain humans to enter its realm—yet to its dismay, these humans failed to abide by the established rules and wantonly divulged the secrets of Zong. Zong had no choice but to revoke their ability to commune with the heavenly spirits and deny them any possibility of rebirth or re-creation..

在过往的纪元⾥，宗界曾经挑选过⼀些⼈类进⼊宗界，却不想⼈类并没有遵守既定的规则，肆意地泄漏宗界机密，宗界只能剥夺他们通达天灵的能⼒，并不予以重⽣再造的可能。

The player's role

The player shall enter Zong as their true "self," without assuming any virtual persona. At this moment, the realm of Zong the player enters is in the midst of the Anima Gravis Arcane Era.

玩家将以真实的“⾃⼰”进⼊宗界，⽆需充当任何虚拟⾓⾊，此时玩家所进⼊的宗界正值稠念纪元。

Zong as the Player Faces It

In the Anima Gravis Arcane Era, the sun sinks into the torrent. Among the Auxiliary Commanders, rebels have become a common sight—these commanders, who once aspired to the "truth, goodness, and beauty," were influenced by humans who had entered Zong to spy on its inner workings in past Arcane Eras. Having absorbed too much of humanity's murky and obscuring qi, they began to tread a path of defiance against Zong. After accumulating over multiple Arcane Eras, these rebellious Auxiliary Commanders have gradually coalesced into the five great clans—Libentia, Ignominia, Avaritia, Procella, and Furia—each clan wreaking havoc upon Zong with its distinct traits. Their understanding of Zong has long since diverged from the generosity and righteousness of their forebears. Their conduct and inclinations have increasingly turned toward taking delight in persecuting other Arcane Ranks and living beings, plunging them into deep misery and distress:

  • Libentia: Those of Libentia do not seek to harm other Arcane Ranks as their goal, yet they often do things that displease them. They derive profound satisfaction and joy from the very displeasure and aversion visibly displayed by others.

  • Ignominia: Those of Ignominia wield words as their primary weapon. They delight in using speech to provoke disgust and repulsion in others, and possess certain skills that shield their verbal assaults from being countered or turned back upon themselves.

  • Avaritia: Those of Avaritia find their sole source of pleasure in depriving other Arcane Ranks of life and property. Brutal and callous, they rarely exhibit exaggerated expressions or overt gestures; their modus operandi is simply to silently slay other Arcane Ranks and beings of Zong, marking their deeds, thereby gratifying the sentiments they harbor toward the very fabric of Zong's temporal-spatial realm.

  • Procella: Those of Procella specialize in "throwing the endeavors of others into chaos" as their delight. They are ever eager to probe into the affairs of other Arcane Ranks, learning of their intended courses of action, and then corrupting their spiritual roots to render their plans unattainable. They are fervently devoted to disrupting the trajectories of others, believing that their very purpose in this dimensional expanse is to ensure that others cannot accomplish what they set out to achieve.

  • Furia: Those of Furia are prone to wrath, yet their anger never betrays itself upon their countenance. They deal devastation through explosive, crushing strikes, and even after inflicting such damage, their fury remains unappeased. They take no pleasure in verbal attacks. Unlike those of Avaritia, they do not rejoice in the taking of lives; rather, they delight in having many witnesses behold their explosive assaults upon a single target. Whenever the malevolent thoughts of Furia erupt, multiple Arcane Ranks are invariably present to bear witness.

玩家所⾯临的宗界：

稠念纪元，⽇沉洪流。⼠将中屡见不鲜宗界中的叛乱分⼦，原本也是向往“真善美”的⼠将们在过去的纪元⾥，受进⼊宗界中窥视究竟的⼈类的影响，吸⼊了太多⼈类的晦涩之⽓，开始⾛向⼀条挑衅宗界的道路。经过多个纪元的积累，现叛乱的⼠将们逐渐形成“流”、“耻”、“欲”、“扯”、“嗔”五⼤系，每个系都以不同的特质为祸于宗界，他们对于宗界的认知已早不如他们的先宗⼀样慷慨正义，他们的⾏为模式与性格倾向逐渐趋向于以迫害宗界他将与其他⽣灵为乐，让其他将们及⽣灵们处于⽔深⽕热之中：

“流”系：流者不以伤害他将为⽬的，但他们常作出让他将们不开⼼的事情，他们常能从他将表⾯所呈现出来的不开⼼以及反感中获得灵魂深处的满⾜与快乐；

“耻”系：耻者多⽤于⾔语，他们喜欢⽤⾔语来让他将厌恶以及反感，他们⽤有⼀定的技能可以保护⾃⼰攻击他⼈的⾔语不被反攻击；

“欲”系：欲者专以剥夺他将的⽣命与财产为快乐的源泉。他们暴虐冷酷，常⽆夸张的表情、夸张的⾏为，他们的⾏为模式只是默默地将他将以及宗界⽣灵杀害，并做上标记，以此来满⾜他们对于宗界时空所寄托的感情；

“扯”系：扯者，专以“乱他将所为”为快乐。他们常常乐于探索宗界中他将的信息，知道其他将们接下来的⾏动⽅向，然后祸其灵根，让其他宗将⽆法实施⾃⼰的计划，他们对于打乱他将的总结轨迹充满热爱，他们觉得来到这⽅天地时空的意义在于让他将办不到他们想要办到的事情；

“嗔”系：嗔者易怒，且怒不形于⾊。多以爆击式伤害对他将造成重创，且造成伤害的同时仍不能平其怒。嗔者不喜⾔语攻击。与欲者不同，嗔者不以褫夺他⼈⽣命为喜，嗔者以多将见证他对某将的爆击伤害为喜。嗔者爆发邪念时，均有多名宗将在场。

As time wore on, the Coalition of the Five Clans of Corruption grew increasingly powerful. They began to plunder and steal various ability scrolls, seeking to gain control over the living beings of Zong. At the same time, they subjected the other Arcane Ranks within Zong to unrelenting persecution. In the Anima Gravis Arcane Era, the Five Clans gradually drained the waters of the Centiwell—the very source upon which the Arcane Ranks of Zong relied on to sustain their memories. Deprived of this fount of remembrance, the Arcane Ranks scattered in disarray, their whereabouts unknown.

随着时间的推移，五系联盟的势⼒愈渐壮⼤，他们开始掠夺、盗取不同的能⼒卷轴，意图控制宗界中的各⽅⽣灵。与此同时，他们也对宗界中其它的将们进⾏⽆休⽌的迫害。稠念纪元的五系已经逐渐抽⼲了百井之⽔，宗界将们靠这百井之⽔来维持将们的记忆，失去了记忆⼒源泉的宗将们纷纷离散、不知去向。

The Player's Mission

When the player first enters Zong, they will encounter Sol—the first Supreme Commander of Zong—at Centiwell. Sol will tell the player that, having obtained The Spiritual Eye of Retinentia, he has retained all his memories intact. He invites the player to set off with him immediately, to help him find his scattered and displaced kin, and to aid in restoring their memories. At the same time, the player must join Sol in seeking a way to save the Centiwell. Sol asks the player what they do in the earthly realm of the human world, and warns them that the road ahead is fraught with perils. He expresses his hope that the player will find a sense of purpose within Zong, and journey forth with a heart full of accomplishment at every step.

The player will later learn through the heavenly spirit of Simian that Zong has been divided by the Five Clans into the Septo-Dimensions, each sealed with barriers of arcane obstruction. These seven dimensions are:

  • The Dimension of Primordial Initiation

  • The Dimension of Benevolent Perseverance

  • The Dimension of Sibling Fondness

  • The Dimension of Amatory Desire

  • The Dimension of Perennial Verdure

  • The Dimension of Multiversal Connection

  • The Dimension of Gracious Transcendence.

The Five Clans have lured the twenty-eight ruling Arcane Ranks of Zong into these seven distinct dimensions, with four Arcane Ranks confined within each. The four within any given dimension may only come to know one another within that same dimensional confine, unable to breach its boundaries. At present, both the player and Sol find themselves trapped within the first dimension—the Dimension of Primordial Initiation. Within this dimension, two other Supreme Commanders of Zong await their discovery. Only the player can successfully lead the ruling Arcane Ranks from each dimension to a secret sanctuary to recover their memories, while Sol must remain confined to the first dimension. The player must pass through the trials of all Septo-Dimensions in order to rescue the scattered Arcane Ranks currently adrift within them, escort them to the secret sanctuary for memory restoration, and simultaneously uncover the means to save the waters of the Centiwell.

玩家的使命：

当玩家初次进⼊宗界，会在百井⽳遇见宗界的第⼀位上上将兵，兵会告诉向玩家他因为取得了记忆灵后裔的瞳孔，所以仍然保持着全部的记忆⼒，他邀请玩家与他即刻启程，帮他找到⾃⼰四散流离的族裔，并且帮助他们恢复记忆。与此同时，玩家还需要和兵⼀起找到拯救百井的⽅法。兵询问玩家在⼈间地球上都做些什么，并告诉玩家前路困难重重，希望玩家在宗界⾥收获存在感，并⼀路满载成就感。

玩家会在后来通过禀禹的天门灵了解到此时的宗界已被五系⽤拆分成了七⼤回门，且布了法障。这七⼤回门分别是：

  • 第⼀回门——宗动门；

  • 第⼆回门——举仁门；

  • 第三回门——姊幼门；

  • 第四回门——欢涩门；

  • 第五回门——长青门；

  • 第六回门——世连门；

  • 第七回门——永隽门。

五系把宗界⼆⼗⼋位掌将引到这七道不同的回门之中，每道回门中有四位掌将，四将只能在同⼀回门中相识，⽆法突破这回门之沿。⽽⽬前玩家与兵深陷于第⼀回门——宗动门。宗动门⾥还有另外两位宗界上上将等待他们去寻找，且只有玩家可以成功地把每⼀道回门中的掌将带⼊秘密驻地去恢复记忆，⽽兵只能留在第⼀回门之中。玩家需要通过七⼤回门的考验，才能解救⽬前在不同回门中游荡的各位宗将，将其带⼊秘密驻地疗养记忆⾥，同时寻找出解救百井⽔源的⽅法。

Player Experiences

The player will be able to communicate with the beings of Zong through the Zong's Imprint bestowed by Sol. The player's journey within Zong may be broadly divided into three dimensions: first, challenge and combat; second, livelihood and production; and third, love and companionship.

  • First: Throughout the passage of the Septo-Dimensions, the player will encounter challenges of every kind. For instance, within the first dimension—the Dimension of Primordial Initiation—the player must do battle with the Offenders of Zong, fight the Osteospectral Tiger, assist Ves in gathering Papaver rhoeas, join forces with others to confront the Barrier of Furia, face the "Two Dragons Emerging from Water," and more.

  • Second: Amidst the trials and tribulations, the player will also experience the rich and varied life of Zong—such as helping Phae prepare silver bean cakes, crafting Jade suits alongside Sol, and more.

  • Third: Along the path through the Septo-Dimensions, the player will encounter living beings of Zong—serpents, birds, fish, insects, and the like. The player may choose to bring them along on the journey, or to pay them no heed.

Only after passing through the layered trials of each dimension and experiencing the full spectrum of life within them can the player earn the trust of the Arcane Ranks, becoming their companion on the road ahead. In time, the player will gradually become a faithful envoy bridging humanity and Zong, entrusted with delivering the Tabulae Grana from Zong to the earthly realm.

玩家的经历：

玩家会通过兵给予的宗印来与宗界生灵沟通交流，在宗界中的经历，可以大概分为三个层面，第一：挑战与斗争；第二：生活和生产；第三：爱与陪伴。

• 第一：在历经这七大回门的过程中，玩家会遇到形形色色的挑战，例如在第一回门——宗动门的经历中，玩家需要斗战宗犯、斗战宗灵骨透虎、帮助贾捻虞美人、与一众一起斗战嗔帐、二龙出水等等。

• 第二：披荆斩棘的同时，玩家也会历经丰富多彩的宗界生活，比如帮助秀制作菽块、与兵一起炮制玉柙等等。

• 第三：玩家也会在走过七大回门的路途之中，遇见蛇鸟鱼虫之类的宗界生灵，玩家可以带上他们一起上路，也可以选择置之不理。 当玩家通过每一个回门的层层考验、历经每一个回门之内的生活百态，方可获得一众宗将的信任，成为与宗将们一同前行的伙伴，也会慢慢成为连接人类与宗界之间的信者，帮助将宗界的周秭信函传送到人间地球。

Player's Gains

The player's experiences and growth throughout Zong will be recorded and reflected through the Pitasarah tree, with their progression ranking displayed via Pitasarah values. Moreover, Pitasarah can serve many other purposes—for instance, it can be used to awaken the heavenly spirits within various Zong artifacts, thereby granting the player access to those artifacts. The Arcane Ranks accompanying the player will take great interest in the player's well-being and daily life, and will encourage them to press forward with courage. Within Zong, the player will not only achieve self-transcendence, but also receive genuine and profound care and affection.

玩家所得：

玩家在宗界中的经历细节、成长过程会通过文旦树来记录反馈，玩家们的成长排位会通过文旦值来反馈，同时，文旦还可以作许多用途，例如可以用文旦来点亮宗界中不同宗器的天门灵，从而获得该宗器等等。各位同行的宗将会十分关心玩家的状态和生活宗将们也会鼓励玩家一路勇往直前，玩家能在宗界里实现自我超越，并且得到真挚又强烈的关心和爱。

First Dimension: Dimension of Primordial Initiation

The player enters Zong as themselves, meets Sol, and gets the Primordial Imprint. It's the Anima Gravis era. The Five Clans stole the Hundred Wells' water, making Generals lose their memories. Sol asks the player to find his lost kin and restore their memories. The player meets Ves, Eon, and Phae, helps them through trials: pressing 73 buttons, drawing a sword, piercing a controller, fighting bronze rat and Two Dragons, etc. Simian gives gifts. Sol offers Zong artifacts for Pitasarah fragments, teaches a mantra, then leaves. The player sails into the water barrier.

第一回门：宗动门：

玩家以真实身份进入宗界，遇上将兵获宗印。时为稠念纪元，五系联盟偷取百井水源，致众将记忆流失。兵邀玩家寻找失散族裔、恢复记忆。先后遇见贾、永、秀三位上上将，助其通过重重考验：比云梯按下73枚按钮、悬棺崖拔出请缨剑、金盔银甲刺穿控制器、嗔帐斗铜鼠破禅钟、祀月洞接蛇取胆汁制菽浆、消洪岭战五只衿酉嶙及双龙。禀禹赠离散之眼、白毓土、斗伞。战后兵陈列十三件宗器供玩家以文旦粒兑换，授“同宗心诀”后离去。玩家驶入水障......

Synopsis

LV1 - The Centiwell

  • As the player, you will enter Zong as your true self on human earth, and meet one of the four Supreme Commanders in the Cave of Centiwell. Sol sees your appearance and senses the human aura from you, he then quickly stamps Zong's Imprint on your finger. Zong's Imprint connects humans and Zong for information exchange. Only with Zong's Imprint can Zong's beings hear the voices of humans, and only with the Imprint can humans move freely in the world of Zong. Sol tells you that the current time and space is Era of Anima Gravis...

关卡一：百井涸

  • 作为玩家，你将作为人间地球上真实的自己进入宗界，并在百井穴中遇见四位上上将之一——兵。兵看到你的模样，感知到了你身上的人类气息，便迅速将宗印印在你的手指上。宗印连接着人类与宗界，用以交流信息。唯有拥有宗印，宗界的生灵才能听见人类的声音；也唯有拥有宗印，人类才能在宗界的世界中自由行动。兵告诉你，当下的时空正值稠念纪元……

LV2 - Cliffside Tiger

  • When Sol and you walk out of the secret passageway of Centiwell, a dangerous cliff appears in front of you. Sol tells you that this place is called "Boreas Gorge". Standing on the edge of the cliff, Sol notices that there is an Osteospectral Tiger nearby. He tells you to pay attention to your own safety, because the Osteospectral Tiger would attack humans from the earth...

关卡二：临崖虎

  • 当兵和你走出百井的秘密通道时，一道险峻的悬崖出现在你们面前。兵告诉你，这个地方叫做“北风峡”。站在悬崖边缘，兵注意到附近有一只宗灵骨透虎。他叮嘱你要注意自身安全，因为宗灵骨透虎会攻击来自人间地球的人类……

LV3 - The Captives

  • Sol snaps his fingers and recites the Mantra Karida, an old wooden bridge connecting the cliffs on both sides appearing in front of you. Sol tells you that this bridge is called "Bridge of Atomos". Those who have committed wrongs in the dimension of Zong—commonly referred to as the Captives of Zong—are hung by their ankles underneath the bridge, facing into the abyss below, as a stern reprimand of their egregious offenses. Even though living beings native to Zong can traverse the bridge with ease, a foreign being such as yourself will weigh it down significantly, alerting the Captives of Zong of your presence. They will flock to attack you once they become aware of you...

关卡三：犯凝渊

  • 兵打了个响指，念诵起心诀。一座连接两岸悬崖的古老木桥出现在你们面前。兵告诉你，这座桥叫做“原子桥”。那些在宗界中犯下过错的生灵——通常称为宗犯——会被脚踝倒吊在桥下，面向下方的深渊，以此作为对他们严重罪行的严厉惩戒。尽管宗界本地的生灵可以轻松过桥，但像你这样来自外界的生灵会显著加重桥的负荷，从而惊动桥下的宗犯。一旦他们察觉到你的存在，便会蜂拥而至攻击你……

LV4 - Papaver Rhoeas

  • After defeating Captives under the bridge, you arrive at the Dent Area. Surprisingly, thousands of flowers fall from the sky in an instant. The information shows that the flower in the sky is called Papaver Rhoeas. Soon, Ves appears in the glowing light of Papver Rhoeas. Ves is one of the four Supreme Commanders in Zong during the arcane era of Anima Gravis, who is in a Spiritual Conjunction with Sol. Ves is often lachrymose and frequently recounts tales of past sufferings, bygone longings, and ancestral accomplishments. Her wistful tales are memorialized in melodies abundant with emotions and commendable virtues. She has lost her memory and the ability to memorize in the Era of Anima Gravis. As she senses your human identity, she decides to pave a flower ledge for you...

关卡四：虞美人

  • 在击败桥下的宗犯后，你来到了凹陷区域。令人惊讶的是，刹那间漫天飘落成千上万的花朵。信息显示，空中的这种花名为虞美人。很快，贾在虞美人的光芒中现身。贾是稠念纪元宗界四位上上将之一，与兵结为连理。贾常常泪水涟涟，频繁讲述过往的苦难、逝去的渴望以及先祖的功绩。她那充满感伤的故事被谱写成旋律，饱含深情与可敬的美德。在稠念纪元中，她失去了记忆，也丧失了记忆的能力。当她感知到你的人类身份后，决定为你铺设一座花台……

LV5 - Jade Burial Suit

  • After you break the Flower Ledge, you start taking a flower raft with Ves and Sol to traverse in the river. Suddenly, a huge crucible slowly appears in the center of Boreas Gorge. Sol looks a little surprised. He tells you that this crucible was used to make Jade Burial Suits. A Jade Burial Suit is created by stringing precious jade stones from Lake Li’er with the Golden Strings from Zong's Canaries, which are then fused together with the flames of burning Papaver Rhoeas. Creating and offering Jade Suits in sacrifices is one of the highest forms of memorial ceremonies in Zong. Jade Suits can be used to honor Commanders who have perished. Depending on the circumstances of a Commander’s passing, such as location or cause of death, a Jade Suit can be burned, worn, submerged, or catapulted during their memorial ceremony...

关卡五：花炼柙

  • 在你突破花台之后，你与贾和兵一同乘上花筏，在河流中穿行。突然，一口巨大的坩埚缓缓出现在北风峡的中心。兵略显惊讶。他告诉你，这口坩埚是用来制作玉柙的。玉柙的制作方法是将来自里儿湖的珍贵玉石与宗界金丝雀的金线串在一起，再用燃烧的虞美人之火加以熔合。制作玉柙并在祭祀中供奉，是宗界最高形式的纪念仪式之一。玉柙可用于祭奠已故的将。根据将离世时的不同情况（例如地点或死因），可在其纪念仪式上对玉柙采取焚烧、穿戴、沉水或抛掷等方式进行处理……

LV6 - Mount of Simian

  • After you collect Jade Burial Suit in LV5, you approach ahead with Sol and Ves together on the flower raft. The gloomy wind in Boreas Gorge is fierce, and an ape statue appears in front of you. Simian was a Zong Commander whose true form was an ape. Known for his exceptional valor and benevolence, Simian would come to any living being or Commander’s rescue if they’re at risk of being harmed by vicious forces. Simian’s offsprings have formed a close bond with each other; they live in harmony and leave their mortal coil in pairs. After Simian passed away, each of his offsprings retrieved a mouthful of white soil at the peak of Mount Almitas. They sculpted the soil after Simian’s image on top of the mountain where Simian last appeared. The mountain was therefore named Mount Simian...

关卡六：禀禺峰

  • 当你在第五关收集到玉柙后，与兵和贾一同乘花筏继续前行。北风峡中阴风凛冽，一座猿猴雕像出现在你面前。禀禺曾是宗界的一位将，其真身为猿。禀禺以其非凡的英勇和仁爱而著称，但凡有生灵或将面临恶势力伤害的危险，他必定会前来营救。禀禺的后代彼此之间结下了深厚的情谊；他们和睦共处，成双成对地离世。禀禺去世后，他的每个后代都在阿尔米塔斯山的峰顶取来一口白毓土，用这些泥土在禀禺最后现身的那座山顶上塑成他的形象。这座山因此得名禀禺山……

LV7 - The Cloud-Mounting Ladder

  • After leaving Mount of Simian, the player, Sol, and Phae raft into a gorge where thunderous clouds swirl—the Cloud-Mounting Ladder. Two giant pillars bristle with rotating levers (30°–120°), some tipped with red buttons. Sol explains that Arcane Ranks can fly straight to Hanging-Coffin Cliff, but the player must dodge the levers and press 73 red buttons to stop the ladder. Warning of lightning interference, Sol carries the sleeping Ves to the cliff. After the player's tenth press, Sol joins in—his presses don't count. When all 73 buttons glow, the ladder stops. Sol chants the Mantra Kardia, and they ascend.

关卡七：比云梯

  • 离开禀禹峰后，玩家、兵与秀乘花筏深入峡谷。前方云雨翻涌，雷霆万钧——那便是禀禹所说的“比云梯”。两根塔吊般的主轴矗立天地间，其上密布着可伸缩转动的杠杆，倾角30度，间杂60度与120度支臂。杠杆缓慢旋转，部分顶端闪烁红色按钮。兵告知：宗将可直飞悬棺崖，但玩家作为外来者，须躲避撞击并按下73枚红色按钮，比云梯方能停转。兵嘱托注意闪电干扰视线，随即抱起昏睡的贾先行登崖。玩家按下第十枚按钮后，兵飞下协同按钮，其所按不计入玩家进度。待73枚按钮全亮，比云梯停转。兵念动心诀，二人登梯升崖......

LV8 - Hanging-Coffin Cliff

  • The player ascends to Hanging-Coffin Cliff. A suspended coffin hums with fallen Zong spirits. A sword trembles within a stone crevice, glowing violet. Sol finds no trace of Eon. Raising the Invisible Dhvaja, Sol determines Eon is ahead and unhidden. The player fails to draw the sword. They open the coffin—a military scroll emerges. The player follows its method and draws the "Valorous Wish". Ves cries out—the heavenly spirit of Bande emerges, restoring Ves's memory of Sol. Eon appears. Sol proposes helping Eon recover his golden helmet and silver armor in exchange for restoring his memories. Eon agrees to gift the sword if the player succeeds. The group descends to the floral raft and continues onward...

关卡八：悬棺崖

  • 玩家乘比云梯登上悬棺崖。悬棺悬空而立，内传先宗陨灭之灵的哼鸣。山石裂缝中藏有一柄宝剑，不时嗡鸣，腾起紫光。兵寻永不见，升起隐身幢探测，断定永在峡谷正前方且未隐身。玩家首次拔剑失败，二人推开悬棺，浑然之气腾出，显现兵书卷轴。玩家取出后依末尾之法拔出请缨剑。拔剑瞬间，贾惊喊“姐姐”——悬棺中飞出“奎”的天门灵，贾受刺激记起兵的身份。永出现，认出玩家。兵提议帮永追寻金盔银甲以换其恢复记忆。永答应若追回便将请缨剑赠予玩家。众人乘比云梯下降至花筏，继续前行......

LV9 - Golden Helmet and Silver Armor

  • The golden helmet and silver armor appear, spinning rapidly to surround the group. The player's Zong's Imprint triggers the Eye of Discernment. Sol suspects the Five Clans have corrupted the heavenly spirits within.The player sees two faceless spirits—each with a glowing yellow ring on its abdomen: a controller. Sol and Ves attack the Helm. Eon and the player face the Armor. The Armor spirit attacks from five directions. The player must pierce its controller with the "Valorous Wish". Each hit costs 5 Pitasarah fragments.After defeating both spirits, the Helm and Armor return to Eon. He gifts the sword to the player. The group continues their search for Phae…

关卡九：金盔银甲

  • 花筏前行，金盔银甲骤然闪现，极速旋转将众人围住。玩家宗印弹出“离散之眼”，兵推测五系控制了其中天门灵，令玩家速速触发以窥真相。玩家触发后，见金盔银甲实为两个透明无脸的天门灵，腹部有明黄光圈——兵断定那是五系安插的控制器。兵与贾迎战金盔，永与玩家合攻银甲。银甲天门灵以钢圈从五向攻击：顶、前、后、左、右。玩家须用请缨剑刺穿其腹部控制器。每被击中一次流失5颗文旦粒，耗尽则须启用时空倒置重来。击败银甲后，兵将疲惫的金盔拖来，玩家同样熄灭其控制器。金盔银甲重回永身，永兑现承诺将请缨剑赠予玩家。众人继续前行寻秀……

LV10 - Barrier of Furia

  • The raft sails into mist of green and gold interwoven. Sol identifies it as the "The Barrier of Furia," a trap of the Five Clans. Inside, the player fans a banana leaf to dispel mist within 2 meters — after 3 seconds, it rushes back at 2 m/s. Eon uses his Smoke Array; Sol and Ves fan together.At 2 minutes and 30 seconds, four maroon air sacs appear. Each breaks open, releasing bronze rat, rooster, snake, and a headless ox. Ves's tear falls on the ox head. The mist vanishes.The rat attacks. Then Nephri's staff traps the three Generals inside a bell. The player withstands 31 strikes alone. Eon recalls a Mantra Kardia — the Sword of Invocation blazes violet with a green pearl on its hilt. After ten heavy blows, bell and staff rise. The three escape. They continue seeking Phae…

关卡十：嗔帐渡厄

  • 花筏驶入青绿与金黄交织的迷雾，禅钟声变幻莫测。兵认出此为五系所设“嗔帐”，入内必遭暴击。破除之法唯有深入其中，找到控制迷雾的器具。众人入帐，玩家持芭蕉叶持续扇动方可护体，每扇一次驱散半径2米内迷雾，3秒后迷雾以每秒2米反噬。永以默烟阵、兵与贾合力扇叶各自抵御。第2分30秒，永发现四个赭红气囊。兵决定各破一囊——囊破后飞出木签，显现青铜鼠、鸡、蛇及无身牛头。贾落泪滴于牛头，嗔帐瞬间消散。铜鼠攻击众人后败退。旋即珞琭玄杖飞至，将三将吸入禅钟。玩家独抗玄杖三十一回合，永忆起增强请缨剑的心诀，剑燃紫焰、柄生明珠。玩家重击玄杖十次后，钟杖同升天际。三将脱困，众人继续前行寻秀……

LV11 - Cave Reverentia

  • The floral raft enters red translucent Cave Reverentia. Its ceiling—crimson soil of looms from Pallium. UI prompts collecting a handful; five soils yield "Mantra Kardia of the Five Soils." Vines harbor Fossa Snakes—serpentine with dragon claws, golden cruciform bellies. Phae dances in white light, memory-lost. She tests the player: catch 180+ airborne snakes barehanded in 12 minutes. Passing, Phae produces a Flora Straw for bile extraction—or repel Buteo with Wingblade Lasso; bile extraction triggers Buteo swarms and random events. Success lets Phae open the exit. The raft sails on...

关卡十一：祀月洞

  • 花筏驶入红色透明的祀月洞。洞顶为慈化纪元上将扶巾所毁机杼之土——赤锭土凝聚而成。UI提示玩家可于此收取一抔赤锭土，集五土可得“五土心诀”。洞内藤蔓密布，庸渠蛇盘踞——形似蛇而有龙爪，腹有十字金光。一束白光映照下，秀翩然起舞，却对众人失去记忆。秀提议考验玩家能力：十二分钟内徒手接住腾空的庸渠蛇，放入竹篓，接蛇数需达180条以上。通过后，秀取出蓊管，与玩家合作取胆汁。玩家可选择取胆汁或退散漭鵟。取胆汁时，漭鵟数量随滴数激增，伴随随机意外事件；退散漭鵟则需用栖翼绳阻击。合作完成且达标后，秀引导玩家打开洞中出口，花筏继续前行……

LV12 - Silver Bean Pond

  • The raft reaches a carbon-black stone wall with shifting patterns. Phae calls it the "Third Minor Trial." After the player selects a Zong artifact, Phae spits a gleaming "silver bean" into the wall, and the player traces circles around it with the artifact, carving a vortex cavity. Phae hands a vine and orders 100 stirs to solidify the gel into bean pulp. At stir 60, a being emerges. A Fossa Snake appears, begging to be taken in the Creatura Voluta—the player may accept or refuse. At 100 stirs, Phae adds snake bile; the pulp bursts with purple-gold light. Phae summons a female Humus Spider to spin silk, and the player dips in their hand—thenceforth immune to frost and flame. The wall collapses. UI prompts collecting crimson soil of looms. Three Arcane Ranks appear. Phae agrees to join. They press onward…

关卡十二：菽浆池

  • 花筏行至碳黑石壁前，壁面图案纵横变幻。秀告诉玩家此处为“第三小试”。玩家选好宗器后，秀吐出一粒璀璨的“银菽”遁入墙壁，令玩家用宗器围绕银菽画圆。玩家切割石壁，露出漩涡式洞壁。秀递来藤条，命玩家搅拌一百圈使胶状流体固化为菽浆。搅拌途中庸渠蛇现身，请求玩家将其收入生灵卷轴带走。玩家可选择答应或拒绝。搅拌至六十圈时，菽浆中生出茵生娘。百圈已满，秀让玩家加入此前提取的蛇胆汁，菽浆爆出紫金光芒。秀唤出夷陆雌蛛织丝覆膜，令玩家将手浸入菽块，自此手不畏寒冰烈焰。石壁崩塌，UI提示玩家收集赤锭土。三将显形，秀答应同行。众人穿洞向前……

LV13 - Floodway Ridge (Part One)

  • The raft reaches Floodway Ridge. Torrents rage, burying countless lost souls. Sol fears the Five Clans will summon them. Bande—leader of Procella—descends, taunting that they've obtained the Spirit-summon Silk. Phae binds his neck with her hair. Enraged, Bande summons five Ribbon Alp Scorpions: Lightning, Spitting Fire, Scattered Wind, Flooding Aqua, Exploding Thunder. Sol, Ves, Eon, and Phae each fight one; the player battles the Flooding Aqua scorpion with the Umbrella Pugna—defending from all sides, landing 100 hits with wood peppercorns. The four return victorious. Bande chants again—two ships emblazoned with "Procella" rise. Formations shift. Fade to black…

关卡十三：消洪岭（一）

  • 花筏行至消洪岭，水势湍急，渊底埋藏无数冤殒之灵。兵担心五系召唤回灵，后患无穷。“扯”系首领贲艾从天而降，以谄媚挑衅一众，声称五系已获调灵帛书。秀以发丝锁其脖颈，贲艾大怒，唤出五只衿酉嶙：闪电、喷火、散风、淹水、炸雷。兵、贾、永、秀各战一兽，玩家以斗伞对抗淹水衿酉嶙。玩家需防御前后左右袭来的水浪，将伞尖精准切入三层碰撞范围，并以木椒子击中衿酉嶙100次方能取胜。四将击败各自神兽后返回花筏。贲艾再念心诀，两艘绣有“扯”字的船只自水下升起，阵型变幻莫测。画面渐黑，待续……

LV14 - Floodway Ridge (Part Two)

  • Ves deploys the Well-shaped matrix to stall two warships. Bande breaks it, unleashing arrows. Sol uses bamboo crosses, Ves a halberd, Eon radish darts, Phae bean rings—while the player wields DUNXUN to absorb arrows, gaining Pitasarah fragments per catch, losing if struck. Ships extend ox-tongues; four Arcane Ranks net them; the player strikes 38 times with DUNXUN's white thorns to destroy. Ships form "M," releasing twin dragons. Eon and Phae clamp with ribbons; the player lures dragons with DUNXUN's pearl to weaken fury, then hooks with Changyi scythe. The player adapts attacks using "Valorous Wish," Umbrella Pugna, Changyi, and DUNXUN. After 5,000 hits, dragons fall. Sol gifts DUNXUN to the player. A gale sweeps them away…

关卡十四：消洪岭（二）

  • After you defeat the Flood Jinyoulin, the other four commanders finish their battles and return to the raft.

  • Ben Ai casts another spell; two “Procella”‑marked ships rise from the water, form formations, then fade to black.

关卡十三：消洪岭（一）

  • 遭遇扯系首领贲艾；秀以发丝锁其脖颈，触发战斗。

  • 贲艾念诵咒语，召唤五只衿酉嶙（闪电衿酉嶙、喷火衿酉嶙、散风衿酉嶙、淹水衿酉嶙、炸雷衿酉嶙）。

  • 四位宗将各战一兽；你独自迎战淹水衿酉嶙。

  • 使用隐身幢（已由兵涂覆粉末）抵御来自四面八方的水浪冲击；幢尖越接近水浪中心，得分越高。

  • 在水浪间歇期间，从隐身幢发射木椒子攻击淹水衿酉嶙；命中100次即可将其击败。

  • 每次格挡失败损失10文旦粒；每粒木椒子命中获得7文旦粒。

  • 击败淹水衿酉嶙后，其余四位宗将也各自结束战斗，返回花筏。

  • 贲艾再施法术；两艘绣有"扯"字的战船自水下升起，列阵变幻，画面渐黑。

LV14 - Floodway Ridge (Part Two)

  • Two “Procella” ships ram the Well‑shaped Matrix, then fire 10,000 arrows across five fan‑shaped zones

  • Four commanders each defend one zone; the player defends the central zone using DunXun – aim and push the compass block to absorb arrows

  • Absorbing arrows gains Pitasarah fragments; being hit loses fragments

  • After clearing their zones, the commanders help the player (their kills don’t count toward player’s score)

  • When arrows end, the ships form a sharp angle and a giant ox tongue slaps out

  • Commanders bind the tongue; the player stabs it repeatedly with the white chestnut on DunXun

  • After 25 stabs the chestnut doubles; 13 more stabs kill the tongue → black screen, level complete

关卡十四：消洪岭（二）

  • 两艘"扯"系战船撞击井字罗阵，随后万箭齐发，覆盖五个扇形区域。

  • 四位宗将各守一区；玩家以沌巽镇守中央区域——瞄准并推动罗盘部件以吸收箭矢。

  • 吸收箭矢获得文旦粒，被击中则损失文旦粒。

  • 各区域清理完毕后，宗将们前来协助玩家（他们所杀箭矢不计入玩家得分）。

  • 箭矢耗尽后，战船形成锐角，巨型牛舌猛然拍出。

  • 宗将们以银网束缚牛舌；玩家用沌巽上的白芰刺反复刺击。

  • 刺击25次后白芰刺翻倍；再刺13次即可击杀牛舌 → 画面转黑，关卡完成。

LV15 - Reward Pool

  • Arrive at Boreas Gorge; Sol explains: exchange Pitasarah fragments for instruments behind the red cloths

  • Choose an instrument, light its spirit with fragments, and take it

  • Return to the raft; Sol gives rice → throw it into the river to summon a water ball

  • Fill the engraved board’s binary marks (0 = 1 grain, 1 = 3 grains)

  • Board turns into a letter, golden light flashes, gains 1,000 Pitasarah fragments automatically

  • Sol teaches the Mantra Kardia “Remembering spirits gone with the wind…” – record it in the Creatura Voluta

  • Sail the raft 100 meters forward, pass through a water barrier → black screen, end of Reward Pool

关卡十五：回门结

  • 抵达瞿北峡；兵解释道：可用文旦粒兑换红布后的宗器。

  • 选择一件宗器，以文旦粒点亮其天门灵后取走。

  • 返回花筏；兵赐予稻米 → 撒入江中，召出一颗水球。

  • 在刻板上填入二进制刻痕（0=1粒米，1=3粒米）。

  • 刻板化为周秭信函，金光闪耀，自动获得1000文旦粒。

  • 兵传授心诀"忆灵随风…" —— 将其记录于生灵卷轴之中。

  • 花筏前行百米，穿过一道水障 → 画面转黑，第一回门·宗动门 完结。

Common Features(Across levels)

Pitasarah System

  • Accumulative scores calculation using the Pitasarah Fragment, Pitasarah Segment, Pitasarah Fruit, and the Pitasarah Tree.

Arcane Rank

  • All living beings in Zong have an Arcane Rank. From low to high, they are: Grana - Cyma - Virga - Thalla - Virgulta - Catoma - Palma - Amicula - Umbra - Silva - Auxiliary Commander - Ancillary Commander - Primary Commander - Supreme Commander.

  • Player's Arcane Rank will be shown based on the growth of Pitasarah System.

Level Selection

  • Levels need to be started from The Centiwell. Once six levels are complete, free selection is available on the Main Menu to enter into one certain level.

UI System

  • UI system is presented through the usage of the Imprint granted by Sol in the Centiwell.

  • All information saved can be found through searching tabs in Imprint.

  • UI canvas can be dragged in VR to your best sight.

Mantra Kardia

  • Mantra Kardia is the source power to summon creatures and weapons in the world of Zong. Currently, Mantra Kardias are summoned by commanders/NPCs only.

Immersive Effects

  • Immerse in the striking beauty of Papaver Rhoeas and the Mount of Simian.

Game Items

  • Interact with game items in general

  • 文旦系统

    • 累积分数通过文旦粒、文旦段、文旦果及文旦树进行计算。

  • 玄位

    • 宗界所有生灵皆拥有玄位。由低到高依次为：芥 - 株 - 秧 - 丛 - 齐 - 比 - 枝 - 蓬 - 茵 - 擎 - 士将 - 中将 - 上将 - 上上将。

    • 玩家的玄位将根据其在文旦系统中的成长进度予以显示。

  • 关卡选择

    • 关卡须从百井开始。完成六个关卡后，主菜单将开放自由选择，可进入任一特定关卡。

  • UI系统

    • UI系统通过兵在百井中授予的宗印呈现。

    • 所有已保存信息可通过宗印中的标签页检索查阅。

    • VR中UI画布可拖拽至最佳视野位置。

  • 心诀

    • 心诀是在宗界世界中召唤生灵与宗器的力量之源。目前，心诀仅能由宗将/NPC召唤。

  • 沉浸式效果

    • 沉浸于虞美人与禀禺峰的震撼之美。

  • 游戏物品

    • 与游戏物品进行一般交互。

Note

To keep the proceeding storylines confidential, key features and common features will be updated as we update to a new level.

为对后续剧情保密，关键功能与通用机制将随关卡推进逐步更新。

Overview

English Intro

Zong is a first-person VR novel that takes you on a journey through ancient Eastern history and culture. As an interstellar traveler, you find yourself in the world of Zong, which is currently in a dire situation under the grips of the Five Clans of Corruption. You will be completing missions to save ancient civilization from the corruptive forces and transmit important learnings to earth, while being guided by Zong's spiritual leaders, the four Supreme Commanders. As you progress through the game, you will encounter various challenges that require strategy, skill, and wit. Get ready to cast spells, summon magical creatures, solve puzzles, collect rare items, and more!

中文简介

在浩大的宇宙里，存在着一个时空维度——宗界，宗界是高级文明的始祖，生生不息，维护着无数星河的星际安全，更有着监测人类一族的使命与维护人间地球运转的责任。在过去的时间长河里，宗界与人间地球一直保持着距离，与人类一族各自为生，却没料想随着人类技术的发展与生产力的解放，人类试图逾越自宇宙初开以来与宗界之间的界限，不断地通过各式各样的方式想要抵达宗界，甚至窥探宗界中的动向，扰乱宗界生灵们的生产与生活。宗界生灵们经过商讨，为了预防人类的好奇心破坏宗界与人类一族的界限，决定挑选合适的人类，给他们在宗界中行动与信息交流的权限，如果他们能够经受住宗界的考验并与宗界生灵们和平相处，便给予他们周秭信函，让该选定的人把信函发送到人间地球，作为传递宗界与人间地球之间信息的人类使者。密函里面内容不一，但无一不关乎人类的生命与生活的七大主题：生死、名利、善施、至亲、爱人、博学、友忠。

Zong

The cosmos was in chaos, and Zong first emerged. "Dynamic spirits" and "Still spirits" are the primordial states of all things—they engender and restrain each other, acting as mutual gravitational forces.

宇宙混沌，宗界初开。“动”与“静”为万物之始态，⼆者相⽣相克，互为引⼒。

Zong is the progenitor of advanced civilizations, composed of the Arcane Ranks and a multitude of living beings. Those who hold the title of Arcane Ranks are designated by the corresponding hierarchical grades: Supreme Commander – Primary Commander – Ancillary Commander – Auxiliary Commander. The Supreme Commanders are the highest rulers of Zong, traditionally chosen as two pairs of Primordial Conjunctions—the most virtuous and accomplished among all in Zong—totaling four commanders. The Primary Commanders are the pillars that have stood since the dawn of primordial chaos; they oversee different aspects of Zong, ensuring its normal and peaceful operation. Beneath the pillars are the Ancillary Commanders, who assist the Primary Commanders in managing various affairs across Zong. They are on the path toward becoming Primary Commanders, laboring diligently in hopes of earning recognition from the rulers of Zong. Below the Ancillary Commanders are the Auxiliary Commanders, who are neither managers nor formulators of Zong's rules, but rather adherents to them. In the day-to-day operations of Zong, they safeguard both the living beings of Zong and the lives of the Arcane Ranks.

宗界为⾼级⽂明的始祖，由“将”与⼀众⽣灵组成。若为“将”，则记以相应⽞位：“上上将 - 上将 - 中将 - ⼠将 ”。“上上将”为宗界最⾼之统领，素来由宗界中遴选出的两对最为德才兼备的连理胜任，共四将。“上将”均为万物混沌之初之梁柱，他们分管宗界不同⽅⾯，让宗界可以正常且和平地运转。“中将”为梁柱之下，他们协助上将们⼀起管理宗界中不同⽅⾯的事务，正在⾛向成为“上将”的道路上，他们努⼒耕耘，希冀得到宗界统领们的认可。“⼠将”为中将之下的阶位，他们并⾮宗界规则的管理者和制定者，⽽是规则的遵循者，在⽇常宗界的运营中，他们维护着宗界的⽣灵以及将们的⽣活。

For those who are not of the Arcane Ranks but are living beings of Zong—such as flowers, trees, grasses, serpents, birds, fish, insects, or even shadow spirits that accompany one—they are designated by the corresponding hierarchical grades for beings: Grana – Cyma – Virga – Thalla – Virgulta – Catoma – Palma – Amicula – Umbra – Silva, ranging from lowest to highest, all of whom are members of Zong. These beings are not subject to the constraints of the Arcane Ranks in their daily lives; as long as they do not violate the laws of Zong or endanger the vitality of other beings within Zong, they are free to live as they please. The beings of Zong may engage in self-cultivation, and through this process, they can elevate their Arcane Rank within Zong and correspondingly enhance their life force. Upon reaching the rank of Silva, a being gains the qualification to transform into the form of an Arcane Rank. However, should a being wish to retain its original ecological form, it may decline the opportunity to assume such a form. Thus, it is common to see within Zong that even the Arcane Ranks may appear as flowers, trees, grasses, serpents, birds, fish, insects, or shadow spirits in their company.

若⾮为将，⽽为宗界⽣灵，如花草树⽊，又如蛇鸟鱼⾍，复如影灵随⾏，则记以⽣灵相应的⽞位：“芥 - 株 - 秧 - 丛 - 齐 - ⽐ - 枝 - 蓬 - 茵 - 擎”，由低到⾼均为宗界成员。⽣灵们在⽣活上不受将的制约，只要不违逆宗界之法则，且不危害宗界其他⽣灵的⽣命⼒，便可⾃由地⽣活。宗界的⽣灵可好⽣修养，修养的过程中会提⾼⾃⼰的宗界⽞位与相应的⽣命⼒量。待⽣灵升⾄“擎”位，则可获得幻化为将形的资格，如若⽣灵想要保留⾃⼰原始的⽣态，可以拒绝化为将形的机会。因此，可常见宗界中也有将为花草树⽊、蛇鸟鱼⾍、影灵随⾏。

While maintaining its own self-sustaining operations, Zong also bears the mission of observing human activities and safeguarding the functioning of the earthly realm. Since the dawn of Zong, it has passed through the Gratia Melius and the Cordia Benevolens, and now has arrived at the Anima Gravis. In the bygone Arcane Eras, Zong perceived humanity's growing desire to obtain more information from Zong, and observed that among humans—some burned incense, some lit candles, some prayed, some cried out, and some went so far as to attempt entering Zong by means unacceptable to the Zong lineage, seeking to probe its realities and spy on the movements within. To prevent human curiosity from breaching the boundary between Zong and the human race, Zong resolved to select suitable humans, granting them the authority to operate and exchange information within Zong. If they could withstand the trials of Zong, they would be bestowed with the Tabulae Grana, charging the chosen individuals to transmit the letters to the earthly realm, thereby serving as human envoys bridging Zong and the human world. The contents of the missives vary, yet each without exception pertains to the Seven Principal Themes of Human Life: Vitality, Prosperity, Charity, Consanguinity, Devotion, Erudition, and Amity.

宗界在维持⾃我运转的同时，也兼备观测⼈类活动、维护⼈间地球运转的使命。⾃宗界初开以来，其已然经历了慈化纪元，悯仁纪元，现如今⾛到稠念纪元。在以往的纪元⾥，宗界感受到⼈类想要从宗界获得更多信息的意愿，并发现在⼈类中，有的焚⾹，有的点烛，有的祷告，有的呐喊，更有甚者，试图⽤宗族不能认可的⼿段进⼊宗界中探听虚实，窥视宗界中的动静。为了预防⼈类的好奇⼼破坏宗界与⼈类⼀族的界限，宗界决定挑选合适的⼈类，给他们在宗界中⾏动与信息交流的权限，如果他们能够经受住宗界的考验，便给予他们周秭信函，让该选定的⼈把信函发送到⼈间地球，作为传递宗界与⼈间地球之间信息的⼈类使者。密函⾥⾯内容不⼀，但⽆⼀不关乎⼈类的⽣命与⽣活的七⼤主题：⽣死、名利、善施、⾄亲、爱⼈、博学、友忠。

In the bygone Arcane Eras, Zong once selected certain humans to enter its realm—yet to its dismay, these humans failed to abide by the established rules and wantonly divulged the secrets of Zong. Zong had no choice but to revoke their ability to commune with the heavenly spirits and deny them any possibility of rebirth or re-creation..

在过往的纪元⾥，宗界曾经挑选过⼀些⼈类进⼊宗界，却不想⼈类并没有遵守既定的规则，肆意地泄漏宗界机密，宗界只能剥夺他们通达天灵的能⼒，并不予以重⽣再造的可能。

The player's role

The player shall enter Zong as their true "self," without assuming any virtual persona. At this moment, the realm of Zong the player enters is in the midst of the Anima Gravis Arcane Era.

玩家将以真实的“⾃⼰”进⼊宗界，⽆需充当任何虚拟⾓⾊，此时玩家所进⼊的宗界正值稠念纪元。

Zong as the Player Faces It

In the Anima Gravis Arcane Era, the sun sinks into the torrent. Among the Auxiliary Commanders, rebels have become a common sight—these commanders, who once aspired to the "truth, goodness, and beauty," were influenced by humans who had entered Zong to spy on its inner workings in past Arcane Eras. Having absorbed too much of humanity's murky and obscuring qi, they began to tread a path of defiance against Zong. After accumulating over multiple Arcane Eras, these rebellious Auxiliary Commanders have gradually coalesced into the five great clans—Libentia, Ignominia, Avaritia, Procella, and Furia—each clan wreaking havoc upon Zong with its distinct traits. Their understanding of Zong has long since diverged from the generosity and righteousness of their forebears. Their conduct and inclinations have increasingly turned toward taking delight in persecuting other Arcane Ranks and living beings, plunging them into deep misery and distress:

  • Libentia: Those of Libentia do not seek to harm other Arcane Ranks as their goal, yet they often do things that displease them. They derive profound satisfaction and joy from the very displeasure and aversion visibly displayed by others.

  • Ignominia: Those of Ignominia wield words as their primary weapon. They delight in using speech to provoke disgust and repulsion in others, and possess certain skills that shield their verbal assaults from being countered or turned back upon themselves.

  • Avaritia: Those of Avaritia find their sole source of pleasure in depriving other Arcane Ranks of life and property. Brutal and callous, they rarely exhibit exaggerated expressions or overt gestures; their modus operandi is simply to silently slay other Arcane Ranks and beings of Zong, marking their deeds, thereby gratifying the sentiments they harbor toward the very fabric of Zong's temporal-spatial realm.

  • Procella: Those of Procella specialize in "throwing the endeavors of others into chaos" as their delight. They are ever eager to probe into the affairs of other Arcane Ranks, learning of their intended courses of action, and then corrupting their spiritual roots to render their plans unattainable. They are fervently devoted to disrupting the trajectories of others, believing that their very purpose in this dimensional expanse is to ensure that others cannot accomplish what they set out to achieve.

  • Furia: Those of Furia are prone to wrath, yet their anger never betrays itself upon their countenance. They deal devastation through explosive, crushing strikes, and even after inflicting such damage, their fury remains unappeased. They take no pleasure in verbal attacks. Unlike those of Avaritia, they do not rejoice in the taking of lives; rather, they delight in having many witnesses behold their explosive assaults upon a single target. Whenever the malevolent thoughts of Furia erupt, multiple Arcane Ranks are invariably present to bear witness.

玩家所⾯临的宗界：

稠念纪元，⽇沉洪流。⼠将中屡见不鲜宗界中的叛乱分⼦，原本也是向往“真善美”的⼠将们在过去的纪元⾥，受进⼊宗界中窥视究竟的⼈类的影响，吸⼊了太多⼈类的晦涩之⽓，开始⾛向⼀条挑衅宗界的道路。经过多个纪元的积累，现叛乱的⼠将们逐渐形成“流”、“耻”、“欲”、“扯”、“嗔”五⼤系，每个系都以不同的特质为祸于宗界，他们对于宗界的认知已早不如他们的先宗⼀样慷慨正义，他们的⾏为模式与性格倾向逐渐趋向于以迫害宗界他将与其他⽣灵为乐，让其他将们及⽣灵们处于⽔深⽕热之中：

“流”系：流者不以伤害他将为⽬的，但他们常作出让他将们不开⼼的事情，他们常能从他将表⾯所呈现出来的不开⼼以及反感中获得灵魂深处的满⾜与快乐；

“耻”系：耻者多⽤于⾔语，他们喜欢⽤⾔语来让他将厌恶以及反感，他们⽤有⼀定的技能可以保护⾃⼰攻击他⼈的⾔语不被反攻击；

“欲”系：欲者专以剥夺他将的⽣命与财产为快乐的源泉。他们暴虐冷酷，常⽆夸张的表情、夸张的⾏为，他们的⾏为模式只是默默地将他将以及宗界⽣灵杀害，并做上标记，以此来满⾜他们对于宗界时空所寄托的感情；

“扯”系：扯者，专以“乱他将所为”为快乐。他们常常乐于探索宗界中他将的信息，知道其他将们接下来的⾏动⽅向，然后祸其灵根，让其他宗将⽆法实施⾃⼰的计划，他们对于打乱他将的总结轨迹充满热爱，他们觉得来到这⽅天地时空的意义在于让他将办不到他们想要办到的事情；

“嗔”系：嗔者易怒，且怒不形于⾊。多以爆击式伤害对他将造成重创，且造成伤害的同时仍不能平其怒。嗔者不喜⾔语攻击。与欲者不同，嗔者不以褫夺他⼈⽣命为喜，嗔者以多将见证他对某将的爆击伤害为喜。嗔者爆发邪念时，均有多名宗将在场。

As time wore on, the Coalition of the Five Clans of Corruption grew increasingly powerful. They began to plunder and steal various ability scrolls, seeking to gain control over the living beings of Zong. At the same time, they subjected the other Arcane Ranks within Zong to unrelenting persecution. In the Anima Gravis Arcane Era, the Five Clans gradually drained the waters of the Centiwell—the very source upon which the Arcane Ranks of Zong relied on to sustain their memories. Deprived of this fount of remembrance, the Arcane Ranks scattered in disarray, their whereabouts unknown.

随着时间的推移，五系联盟的势⼒愈渐壮⼤，他们开始掠夺、盗取不同的能⼒卷轴，意图控制宗界中的各⽅⽣灵。与此同时，他们也对宗界中其它的将们进⾏⽆休⽌的迫害。稠念纪元的五系已经逐渐抽⼲了百井之⽔，宗界将们靠这百井之⽔来维持将们的记忆，失去了记忆⼒源泉的宗将们纷纷离散、不知去向。

The Player's Mission

When the player first enters Zong, they will encounter Sol—the first Supreme Commander of Zong—at Centiwell. Sol will tell the player that, having obtained The Spiritual Eye of Retinentia, he has retained all his memories intact. He invites the player to set off with him immediately, to help him find his scattered and displaced kin, and to aid in restoring their memories. At the same time, the player must join Sol in seeking a way to save the Centiwell. Sol asks the player what they do in the earthly realm of the human world, and warns them that the road ahead is fraught with perils. He expresses his hope that the player will find a sense of purpose within Zong, and journey forth with a heart full of accomplishment at every step.

The player will later learn through the heavenly spirit of Simian that Zong has been divided by the Five Clans into the Septo-Dimensions, each sealed with barriers of arcane obstruction. These seven dimensions are:

  • The Dimension of Primordial Initiation

  • The Dimension of Benevolent Perseverance

  • The Dimension of Sibling Fondness

  • The Dimension of Amatory Desire

  • The Dimension of Perennial Verdure

  • The Dimension of Multiversal Connection

  • The Dimension of Gracious Transcendence.

The Five Clans have lured the twenty-eight ruling Arcane Ranks of Zong into these seven distinct dimensions, with four Arcane Ranks confined within each. The four within any given dimension may only come to know one another within that same dimensional confine, unable to breach its boundaries. At present, both the player and Sol find themselves trapped within the first dimension—the Dimension of Primordial Initiation. Within this dimension, two other Supreme Commanders of Zong await their discovery. Only the player can successfully lead the ruling Arcane Ranks from each dimension to a secret sanctuary to recover their memories, while Sol must remain confined to the first dimension. The player must pass through the trials of all Septo-Dimensions in order to rescue the scattered Arcane Ranks currently adrift within them, escort them to the secret sanctuary for memory restoration, and simultaneously uncover the means to save the waters of the Centiwell.

玩家的使命：

当玩家初次进⼊宗界，会在百井⽳遇见宗界的第⼀位上上将兵，兵会告诉向玩家他因为取得了记忆灵后裔的瞳孔，所以仍然保持着全部的记忆⼒，他邀请玩家与他即刻启程，帮他找到⾃⼰四散流离的族裔，并且帮助他们恢复记忆。与此同时，玩家还需要和兵⼀起找到拯救百井的⽅法。兵询问玩家在⼈间地球上都做些什么，并告诉玩家前路困难重重，希望玩家在宗界⾥收获存在感，并⼀路满载成就感。

玩家会在后来通过禀禹的天门灵了解到此时的宗界已被五系⽤拆分成了七⼤回门，且布了法障。这七⼤回门分别是：

  • 第⼀回门——宗动门；

  • 第⼆回门——举仁门；

  • 第三回门——姊幼门；

  • 第四回门——欢涩门；

  • 第五回门——长青门；

  • 第六回门——世连门；

  • 第七回门——永隽门。

五系把宗界⼆⼗⼋位掌将引到这七道不同的回门之中，每道回门中有四位掌将，四将只能在同⼀回门中相识，⽆法突破这回门之沿。⽽⽬前玩家与兵深陷于第⼀回门——宗动门。宗动门⾥还有另外两位宗界上上将等待他们去寻找，且只有玩家可以成功地把每⼀道回门中的掌将带⼊秘密驻地去恢复记忆，⽽兵只能留在第⼀回门之中。玩家需要通过七⼤回门的考验，才能解救⽬前在不同回门中游荡的各位宗将，将其带⼊秘密驻地疗养记忆⾥，同时寻找出解救百井⽔源的⽅法。

Player Experiences

The player will be able to communicate with the beings of Zong through the Zong's Imprint bestowed by Sol. The player's journey within Zong may be broadly divided into three dimensions: first, challenge and combat; second, livelihood and production; and third, love and companionship.

  • First: Throughout the passage of the Septo-Dimensions, the player will encounter challenges of every kind. For instance, within the first dimension—the Dimension of Primordial Initiation—the player must do battle with the Offenders of Zong, fight the Osteospectral Tiger, assist Ves in gathering Papaver rhoeas, join forces with others to confront the Barrier of Furia, face the "Two Dragons Emerging from Water," and more.

  • Second: Amidst the trials and tribulations, the player will also experience the rich and varied life of Zong—such as helping Phae prepare silver bean cakes, crafting Jade suits alongside Sol, and more.

  • Third: Along the path through the Septo-Dimensions, the player will encounter living beings of Zong—serpents, birds, fish, insects, and the like. The player may choose to bring them along on the journey, or to pay them no heed.

Only after passing through the layered trials of each dimension and experiencing the full spectrum of life within them can the player earn the trust of the Arcane Ranks, becoming their companion on the road ahead. In time, the player will gradually become a faithful envoy bridging humanity and Zong, entrusted with delivering the Tabulae Grana from Zong to the earthly realm.

玩家的经历：

玩家会通过兵给予的宗印来与宗界生灵沟通交流，在宗界中的经历，可以大概分为三个层面，第一：挑战与斗争；第二：生活和生产；第三：爱与陪伴。

• 第一：在历经这七大回门的过程中，玩家会遇到形形色色的挑战，例如在第一回门——宗动门的经历中，玩家需要斗战宗犯、斗战宗灵骨透虎、帮助贾捻虞美人、与一众一起斗战嗔帐、二龙出水等等。

• 第二：披荆斩棘的同时，玩家也会历经丰富多彩的宗界生活，比如帮助秀制作菽块、与兵一起炮制玉柙等等。

• 第三：玩家也会在走过七大回门的路途之中，遇见蛇鸟鱼虫之类的宗界生灵，玩家可以带上他们一起上路，也可以选择置之不理。 当玩家通过每一个回门的层层考验、历经每一个回门之内的生活百态，方可获得一众宗将的信任，成为与宗将们一同前行的伙伴，也会慢慢成为连接人类与宗界之间的信者，帮助将宗界的周秭信函传送到人间地球。

Player's Gains

The player's experiences and growth throughout Zong will be recorded and reflected through the Pitasarah tree, with their progression ranking displayed via Pitasarah values. Moreover, Pitasarah can serve many other purposes—for instance, it can be used to awaken the heavenly spirits within various Zong artifacts, thereby granting the player access to those artifacts. The Arcane Ranks accompanying the player will take great interest in the player's well-being and daily life, and will encourage them to press forward with courage. Within Zong, the player will not only achieve self-transcendence, but also receive genuine and profound care and affection.

Synopsis

LV1 - The Centiwell

  • As the player, you will enter Zong as your true self on human earth, and meet one of the four Supreme Commanders in the Cave of Centiwell. Sol sees your appearance and senses the human aura from you, he then quickly stamps Zong's Imprint on your finger. Zong's Imprint connects humans and Zong for information exchange. He tells you to pay attention to your own safety, because the Osteospectral Tiger would attack humans from the earth...

The raft sails on...

关卡十一：祀月洞

  • 花筏驶入红色透明的祀月洞。洞顶为慈化纪元上将扶巾所毁机杼之土——赤锭土凝聚而成。UI提示玩家可于此收取一抔赤锭土，集五土可得“五土心诀”。洞内藤蔓密布，庸渠蛇盘踞——形似蛇而有龙爪，腹有十字金光。一束白光映照下，秀翩然起舞，却对众人失去记忆。秀提议考验玩家能力：十二分钟内徒手接住腾空的庸渠蛇，放入竹篓，接蛇数需达180条以上。通过后，秀取出蓊管，与玩家合作取胆汁。玩家可选择取胆汁或退散漭鵟。取胆汁时，漭鵟数量随滴数激增，伴随随机意外事件；退散漭鵟则需用栖翼绳阻击。合作完成且达标后，秀引导玩家打开洞中出口，花筏继续前行……

LV12 - Silver Bean Pond

  • The raft reaches a carbon-black stone wall with shifting patterns. Phae calls it the "Third Minor Trial." After the player selects a Zong artifact, Phae spits a gleaming "silver bean" into the wall, and the player traces circles around it with the artifact, carving a vortex cavity. Phae hands a vine and orders 100 stirs to solidify the gel into bean pulp. At stir 60, a being emerges. A Fossa Snake appears, begging to be taken in the Creatura Voluta—the player may accept or refuse. At 100 stirs, Phae adds snake bile; the pulp bursts with purple-gold light. Phae summons a female Humus Spider to spin silk, and the player dips in their hand—thenceforth immune to frost and flame. The wall collapses. UI prompts collecting crimson soil of looms. Three Arcane Ranks appear. Phae agrees to join. They press onward…

关卡十二：菽浆池

  • 花筏行至碳黑石壁前，壁面图案纵横变幻。秀告诉玩家此处为“第三小试”。玩家选好宗器后，秀吐出一粒璀璨的“银菽”遁入墙壁，令玩家用宗器围绕银菽画圆。玩家切割石壁，露出漩涡式洞壁。秀递来藤条，命玩家搅拌一百圈使胶状流体固化为菽浆。搅拌途中庸渠蛇现身，请求玩家将其收入生灵卷轴带走。玩家可选择答应或拒绝。搅拌至六十圈时，菽浆中生出茵生娘。百圈已满，秀让玩家加入此前提取的蛇胆汁，菽浆爆出紫金光芒。秀唤出夷陆雌蛛织丝覆膜，令玩家将手浸入菽块，自此手不畏寒冰烈焰。石壁崩塌，UI提示玩家收集赤锭土。三将显形，秀答应同行。众人穿洞向前……

LV13 - Floodway Ridge (Part One)

  • The raft reaches Floodway Ridge. Torrents rage, burying countless lost souls. Sol fears the Five Clans will summon them. Bande—leader of Procella—descends, taunting that they've obtained the Spirit-summon Silk. Phae binds his neck with her hair. Enraged, Bande summons five Ribbon Alp Scorpions: Lightning, Spitting Fire, Scattered Wind, Flooding Aqua, Exploding Thunder. Sol, Ves, Eon, and Phae each fight one; the player battles the Flooding Aqua scorpion with the Umbrella Pugna—defending from all sides, landing 100 hits with wood peppercorns. The four return victorious. Bande chants again—two ships emblazoned with "Procella" rise. Formations shift. Fade to black…

关卡十三：消洪岭（一）

  • 花筏行至消洪岭，水势湍急，渊底埋藏无数冤殒之灵。兵担心五系召唤回灵，后患无穷。“扯”系首领贲艾从天而降，以谄媚挑衅一众，声称五系已获调灵帛书。秀以发丝锁其脖颈，贲艾大怒，唤出五只衿酉嶙：闪电、喷火、散风、淹水、炸雷。兵、贾、永、秀各战一兽，玩家以斗伞对抗淹水衿酉嶙。玩家需防御前后左右袭来的水浪，将伞尖精准切入三层碰撞范围，并以木椒子击中衿酉嶙100次方能取胜。四将击败各自神兽后返回花筏。贲艾再念心诀，两艘绣有“扯”字的船只自水下升起，阵型变幻莫测。画面渐黑，待续……

LV14 - Floodway Ridge (Part Two)

  • Ves deploys the Well-shaped matrix to stall two warships. Bande breaks it, unleashing arrows. Sol uses bamboo crosses, Ves a halberd, Eon radish darts, Phae bean rings—while the player wields DUNXUN to absorb arrows, gaining Pitasarah fragments per catch, losing if struck. Ships extend ox-tongues; four Arcane Ranks net them; the player strikes 38 times with DUNXUN's white thorns to destroy. Ships form "M," releasing twin dragons. Eon and Phae clamp with ribbons; the player lures dragons with DUNXUN's pearl to weaken fury, then hooks with Changyi scythe. The player adapts attacks using "Valorous Wish," Umbrella Pugna, Changyi, and DUNXUN. After 5,000 hits, dragons fall. Sol gifts DUNXUN to the player. A gale sweeps them away…

关卡十四：消洪岭（二）

  • 贾布下“井字罗阵”阻滞两艘战船，贲艾破阵后万箭齐发。兵以编竹十字御箭，贾以蕊戟晗箭，永以萝镖咽箭，秀以菽环加伸。玩家居中持沌巽吸箭，每吸一支得文旦粒，中箭则流失，负值即败。箭尽后船只变阵，伸出巨型牛舌。四将以银色网罩禁锢牛舌，玩家用沌巽所化白芰刺伤38次方灭之。船只再变“M”型，双龙出水。永以藏青缎带、秀以朱红缎带钳龙，玩家以沌巽颛珠诱龙吞食，弱其戾气，随后昌意镰钩刮龙身。双龙联合攻击分三式：逆鳞——网格困龙，玩家钩鳞；启山——震裂山体，碎石化军鼓，玩家以缎带套龙；排江——衔木疗伤，四将祭蒺藜火球与犬殳追击。双龙分开攻击分五组：逆鳞/遁鳞、启山/架石、排江/吐洪、点香/熏艾、遗孤/催灵。玩家需灵活切换请缨剑、斗伞、昌意镰、沌巽等宗器应对。双龙总体受伤达5000次后陨灭。战后秀击退贲艾，兵将沌巽赠予玩家。随后兵拉住玩家，一阵狂风卷来......

LV15 - Reward Pool

  • Sol bestows thirteen Zong artifacts: Morning-glory spear, Hammer of Yawu, Buckthorn Whips, Magnolia Chain, Gan Qi, Fresh Branch Cane, Golden Eagle Claw, Humus Fishing Rod, Xuanqu Cage, Yuguai Staff, Purple Aster Cudgel, Qingma Rope, and Shichen Ring. The player may exchange Pitasarah spheres for them, or purchase Zong rice to trade for one. The player scatters rice into the river, summoning water spheres, and fills the grain indentations to send a message to the human realm—receiving 1,000 Pitasarah fragments in return. Sol recites the "Mantra Kardia of Shared Zong" and vanishes into the wind. The player enters the water barrier—the Dimension of Primordial Initiation comes to an end.

第十五关：回门结

  • 击退玄杖与禅钟，救出兵、贾、永，乘花筏继续前行。

LV11 - Cave Reverentia

  • Enter the Cave Reverentia on the floral raft; learn about the crimson soil of looms and the story of the ancient commander Pallium destroying all looms.

  • Meet Phae; after Sol's introduction, accept her three trials.

  • Trial 1: Catch the rising Fossa Snakes barehanded within 12 minutes; use both hands, place each caught snake into the bamboo basket (one at a time); exceeding the limit loses Pitasarah fragments; catch at least 180 snakes.

  • Trial 2 (choose one of two paths):

    • Extract bile: Use a Flora Straw to draw bile from the golden cross on the snake's abdomen, preventing the snake from slipping away; as bile drops increase, Buteo swarm; Phae uses her hair transformed into ropes to knock them down; you must obtain at least 90% of the bile from the caught snakes.

    • Dispel the Buteo: Wield a Wingblade Lasso to drive away the Buteo entering the cave; each repelled bird gains fragments; failing to repel more than 60 birds results in failure; you can voice‑request Phae to recite a Mantra Kardia to enhance the rope's power.

  • After completing either path, you may use Temporal-Spatial Reset to experience the other.

  • Once both trials are passed, Phae opens the cave's other exit; continues forward on the floral raft.

关卡十一：祀月洞

  • 乘花筏进入祀月洞；了解赤锭土的由来及上古上将扶巾毁尽机杼的往事。

  • 遇见秀；经兵介绍后，接受她的三项试炼。

  • 试炼一：12分钟内徒手捉住腾空的庸渠蛇；双手并用，将所捉之蛇逐一放入竹篓（每次一条）；超出时间限制则损失文旦粒；至少捉满180条。

  • 试炼二（二选一）：

    • 取胆汁：用蓊管从蛇腹金色十字处抽取胆汁，防止蛇身滑脱；随着胆汁滴数增加，漭鵟群涌而至；秀以发丝化为绳索将其击落；须从所捉之蛇中提取至少90%的胆汁。

    • 驱散漭鵟：挥动栖翼绳驱赶进入洞内的漭鵟；每驱散一只获得文旦粒；若未能驱散超过60只则失败；可语音请求秀诵念心诀以增强绳力。

  • 完成任一分支后，可使用时空倒置体验另一分支。

  • 两项试炼皆通过后，秀开启洞穴另一出口；乘花筏继续前行。

LV12 - Silver Bean Pond

  • Before the carbon‑black wall in the Cave Reverentia, choose one Arcane weapon (Invisible Dhvaja or "Valorous Wish").

  • Target the silver bean and carve a full circle on the wall with the weapon (pausing >3 seconds fails).

  • Take a vine and stir the bean pulp vortex 100 times following the marked ring (each stir +2 Pitasarah fragments) until it solidifies.

  • A Fossa Snake appears during stirring; decide whether to take it into the Creatura Voluta (it can assist you later).

  • Yinshengniang emerges from stir 60 onward; at 100 stirs the bean pulp fully congeals.

  • Pour in the bile to trigger purple‑gold light; the Humus Spider spins a web for 1.5 minutes.

  • After webbing, place both hands on the bean pulp block to gain a golden protective film (immune to heat and cold).

  • Phae absorbs the bean pulp block; the wall collapses, opening the cave's other exit.

  • Collect the falling crimson soil of looms into the Creatura Voluta.

  • Sol, Ves, and Eon reappear; all four commanders sail onward with you on the floral raft.

关卡十二：菽浆池

  • 于祀月洞碳黑石壁前，选择一件宗器（隐身幢或请缨剑）。

  • 瞄准银菽，用宗器在壁上画出一个完整的圆（停顿超过3秒即失败）。

  • 取藤条沿标记圆环搅拌菽浆漩涡100圈（每搅一圈获得2文旦粒），直至凝固。

  • 搅拌途中出现庸渠蛇，可选择是否将其收入生灵卷轴（日后可助你一臂之力）。

  • 搅拌至60圈时茵生娘现身；满100圈后菽浆完全凝结。

  • 倒入胆汁引发紫金光华；夷陆蛛吐丝织网，持续1.5分钟。

  • 结网后，双手覆于菽块之上，获得金色护膜（从此不畏寒暑）。

  • 秀将菽块吸收，石壁崩塌，开启洞穴另一出口。

  • 将坠落的赤锭土收入生灵卷轴。

  • 兵、贾、永重新现身；四位宗将与你同乘花筏，继续前行

LV13 - Floodway Ridge (Part One)

  • Confront Ben Ai (leader of Procella); Phae binds his neck with a strand of hair, triggering combat.

  • Ben Ai recites the Tonal Regulating Mantra, summoning five Jinyoulin (Lightning, Flame, Wind, Flood, Thunder).

  • The four commanders each engage one Jinyoulin; you alone face the Flood Jinyoulin.

  • Use the Canopy (coated with powder by Sol) to block water blasts from four directions; the closer the canopy tip to the water’s center, the higher the score.

  • During water‑blast pauses, fire wooden pepper seeds from the Canopy at the Flood Jinyoulin; land 100 hits to defeat it.

  • Each failed block loses 10 Pitasarah fragments; each pepper seed hit gains 7 fragments.

  • After you defeat the Flood Jinyoulin, the other four commanders finish their battles and return to the raft.

  • Ben Ai casts another spell; two “Procella”‑marked ships rise from the water, form formations, then fade to black.

关卡十三：消洪岭（一）

  • 遭遇扯系首领贲艾；秀以发丝锁其脖颈，触发战斗。

  • 贲艾念诵咒语，召唤五只衿酉嶙（闪电衿酉嶙、喷火衿酉嶙、散风衿酉嶙、淹水衿酉嶙、炸雷衿酉嶙）。

  • 四位宗将各战一兽；你独自迎战淹水衿酉嶙。

  • 使用隐身幢（已由兵涂覆粉末）抵御来自四面八方的水浪冲击；幢尖越接近水浪中心，得分越高。

  • 在水浪间歇期间，从隐身幢发射木椒子攻击淹水衿酉嶙；命中100次即可将其击败。

  • 每次格挡失败损失10文旦粒；每粒木椒子命中获得7文旦粒。

  • 击败淹水衿酉嶙后，其余四位宗将也各自结束战斗，返回花筏。

  • 贲艾再施法术；两艘绣有"扯"字的战船自水下升起，列阵变幻，画面渐黑。

LV14 - Floodway Ridge (Part Two)

  • Two “Procella” ships ram the Well‑shaped Matrix, then fire 10,000 arrows across five fan‑shaped zones

  • Four commanders each defend one zone; the player defends the central zone using DunXun – aim and push the compass block to absorb arrows

  • Absorbing arrows gains Pitasarah fragments; being hit loses fragments

  • After clearing their zones, the commanders help the player (their kills don’t count toward player’s score)

  • When arrows end, the ships form a sharp angle and a giant ox tongue slaps out

  • Commanders bind the tongue; the player stabs it repeatedly with the white chestnut on DunXun

  • After 25 stabs the chestnut doubles; 13 more stabs kill the tongue → black screen, level complete

关卡十四：消洪岭（二）

  • 两艘"扯"系战船撞击井字罗阵，随后万箭齐发，覆盖五个扇形区域。

  • 四位宗将各守一区；玩家以沌巽镇守中央区域——瞄准并推动罗盘部件以吸收箭矢。

  • 吸收箭矢获得文旦粒，被击中则损失文旦粒。

  • 各区域清理完毕后，宗将们前来协助玩家（他们所杀箭矢不计入玩家得分）。

  • 箭矢耗尽后，战船形成锐角，巨型牛舌猛然拍出。

  • 宗将们以银网束缚牛舌；玩家用沌巽上的白芰刺反复刺击。

  • 刺击25次后白芰刺翻倍；再刺13次即可击杀牛舌 → 画面转黑，关卡完成。

LV15 - Reward Pool

  • Arrive at Boreas Gorge; Sol explains: exchange Pitasarah fragments for instruments behind the red cloths

  • Choose an instrument, light its spirit with fragments, and take it

  • Return to the raft; Sol gives rice → throw it into the river to summon a water ball

  • Fill the engraved board’s binary marks (0 = 1 grain, 1 = 3 grains)

  • Board turns into a letter, golden light flashes, gains 1,000 Pitasarah fragments automatically

  • Sol teaches the Mantra Kardia “Remembering spirits gone with the wind…” – record it in the Creatura Voluta

  • Sail the raft 100 meters forward, pass through a water barrier → black screen, end of Reward Pool

关卡十五：回门结

  • 抵达瞿北峡；兵解释道：可用文旦粒兑换红布后的宗器。

  • 选择一件宗器，以文旦粒点亮其天门灵后取走。

  • 返回花筏；兵赐予稻米 → 撒入江中，召出一颗水球。

  • 在刻板上填入二进制刻痕（0=1粒米，1=3粒米）。

  • 刻板化为周秭信函，金光闪耀，自动获得1000文旦粒。

  • 兵传授心诀"忆灵随风…" —— 将其记录于生灵卷轴之中。

  • 花筏前行百米，穿过一道水障 → 画面转黑，第一回门·宗动门 完结。

Common Features(Across levels)

Pitasarah System

  • Accumulative scores calculation using the Pitasarah Fragment, Pitasarah Segment, Pitasarah Fruit, and the Pitasarah Tree.

Arcane Rank

  • All living beings in Zong have an Arcane Rank. From low to high, they are: Grana - Cyma - Virga - Thalla - Virgulta - Catoma - Palma - Amicula - Umbra - Silva - Auxiliary Commander - Ancillary Commander - Primary Commander - Supreme Commander.

  • Player's Arcane Rank will be shown based on the growth of Pitasarah System.

Level Selection

  • Levels need to be started from The Centiwell. Once six levels are complete, free selection is available on the Main Menu to enter into one certain level.

UI System

  • UI system is presented through the usage of the Imprint granted by Sol in the Centiwell.

  • All information saved can be found through searching tabs in Imprint.

  • UI canvas can be dragged in VR to your best sight.

Mantra Kardia

  • Mantra Kardia is the source power to summon creatures and weapons in the world of Zong. Currently, Mantra Kardias are summoned by commanders/NPCs only.

Immersive Effects

  • Immerse in the striking beauty of Papaver Rhoeas and the Mount of Simian.

Game Items

  • Interact with game items in general

  • 文旦系统

    • 累积分数通过文旦粒、文旦段、文旦果及文旦树进行计算。

  • 玄位

    • 宗界所有生灵皆拥有玄位。由低到高依次为：芥 - 株 - 秧 - 丛 - 齐 - 比 - 枝 - 蓬 - 茵 - 擎 - 士将 - 中将 - 上将 - 上上将。

    • 玩家的玄位将根据其在文旦系统中的成长进度予以显示。

  • 关卡选择

    • 关卡须从百井开始。完成六个关卡后，主菜单将开放自由选择，可进入任一特定关卡。

  • UI系统

    • UI系统通过兵在百井中授予的宗印呈现。

    • 所有已保存信息可通过宗印中的标签页检索查阅。

    • VR中UI画布可拖拽至最佳视野位置。

  • 心诀

    • 心诀是在宗界世界中召唤生灵与宗器的力量之源。目前，心诀仅能由宗将/NPC召唤。

  • 沉浸式效果

    • 沉浸于虞美人与禀禺峰的震撼之美。

  • 游戏物品

    • 与游戏物品进行一般交互。

Note

To keep the proceeding storylines confidential, key features and common features will be updated as we update to a new level.

为对后续剧情保密，关键功能与通用机制将随关卡推进逐步更新。
